title: Regional supply resilience simulation for model fallback optimization
creator: Liam Chen
description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation and tabletop exercises to map how regional model supply shocks affect latency SLOs and cost for Redwood customers and recommend fallback optimization rules (routing, quantization, reserved-capacity triggers). Scope: generate probabilistic supply outage scenarios across 6 regions, evaluate 4 fallback policies, and produce a guidance matrix and runbook for sales and SRE.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible simulation notebook that models regional supply shocks and outputs expected latency and cost distributions for representative workloads.
A recommendations doc with prioritized fallback rules and thresholds (routing priority, quantization level, reserve allocation) per customer tier.
Consolidated set of test prompts and synthetic workloads used in simulation in the repo with provenance.
Sign-off from SRE and Runtime team on suggested automatic fallback thresholds and alerting hooks.

Action: Priya to define latency SLO buckets and cost model inputs.
